$comment: Character and word limits for agent-generated content. These are TARGET ranges, not hard limits.

subtitle.guidance: Compelling one-liner that captures the neighborhood's essence for dog owners

intro.guidance: Main introduction covering character, dog-friendliness, and honest trade-offs. Should flow naturally, not feel padded.

facilities.intro.guidance: Brief overview of dog-relevant facilities in the neighborhood

dogParks.intro.guidance: Introduction to dog park situation, including alternatives if none exist

vets.intro.guidance: Introduction to veterinary options, honest about distance if far

dailyLife.intro.guidance: What daily life looks like for dog owners, painting a picture

dailyLife.benefits.guidance: Each benefit should be specific and substantive, not generic

houses.intro.guidance: Introduction to housing search, mention postal code filtering

title.note: Page title is generated from neighborhood name, not agent content

metaDescription.note: Derived from subtitle, should work as meta description
